html:
Severe obesity is not just about physical appearance; it is a serious medical condition that can result in life-threatening health problems, such as heart problems, diabetes, and joint failure. Many of our patients at Silver Touch Hospitals in Ahmedabad ask us questions such as whether they could get life-changing weight reduction surgeries without a huge financial burden. Specifically, a common question we hear is whether the Ayushman Bharat Pradhan Mantri Jan Arogya Yojana (PMJAY) covers these procedures.

The response is an optimistic one, though it does carry certain specific medical criteria. As a multispecialty healthcare provider, it is our commitment to make such treatments available in each section of society.

Do you have the same questions? Continue reading.

PMJAY Coverage for Bariatric Procedures

The PMJAY scheme is a programme where a cashless facility is allowed for secondary and tertiary treatment of families that are eligible. Even though bariatric surgery is considered a cosmetic procedure for the average person on the street, this is not the opinion of the government or the medical community at large, where bariatric surgery is a life-saving procedure for people suffering from morbid obesity.

At our branches, we quite frequently have patients walk in as candidates for the government scheme to avail bariatric surgery for weight loss in Ahmedabad. However, the government scheme is only applicable when the nature of the requirement meets the criterion of it being a medical necessity to have the surgery performed. So, it’s not for a prettier look; it’s to live longer and healthier.

Are You Eligible for Cashless Treatment?

To avail of this benefit at Silver Touch Hospitals, certain clinical parameters must be met.

Generally, the scheme considers coverage if:

  • Your Body Mass Index (BMI) is 40 or higher.
  • Your BMI is over 35, and you suffer from severe co-morbidities, such as uncontrolled Type 2 Diabetes, sleep apnea, or heart-related issues.

Prior to progressing further, our team undertakes a significant evaluation process. We make use of our in-house diagnostic facilities, such as 2D Echo, ECG, and blood investigations to evaluate your status. Such analysis is extremely important for the PMJAY approval process because it presents your case as a medical necessity.

The Silver Touch Hospitals Advantage

By choosing Silver Touch Hospitals for your journey towards a new lifestyle through weight loss, you are in safe hands, as we are specialists in laparoscopic surgery, which translates into smaller surgical scars, reduced pain, and a quick recovery. By choosing bariatric surgery for weight loss in Ahmedabad, you are selecting a team that assists you from filling out the PMJAY form to your rehabilitation.

Frequently Asked Questions (FAQs)

  1. Which branch of Silver Touch Hospitals offers PMJAY services?

While we provide consultations across our network, our Nirnay Nagar (Ranip) branch is a primary hub for PMJAY beneficiaries in Ahmedabad seeking cashless surgical care.

  1. Does the scheme cover the cost of medicines and tests?

Yes, if your surgery is approved under PMJAY, the package typically includes the surgery, pre-anesthesia check-ups (like X-rays and blood tests), medicines during hospitalization, and food.

  1. What documents do I need to bring?

You will need your Ayushman Card (Golden Card), Aadhaar Card, and any previous medical reports related to your weight and co-morbidities.
